newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends lower.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends lower.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates shunned a weak peso Monday and fell 140 basis points to 18.00 percent from a high prior close and in the wake of central bank intervention, traders said.
"The peso slid mostly at the close and the market had little time to react," a trader said.
"The session was very calm and if rates did fall, it was because Banco de Mexico assigned low rates (in secondary participation) of 18.05 percent," he added.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts ended 8.4 centavos weaker at 7.9700/7.9800 per dollar.
